skill_selections.name: diagnosing-bugs
skill_selections.trigger: the live entry policy misses every dollar target
skill_selections.decision: Require a red-capable receipt that measures the present shortfall and the information-versus-payoff trade at each allowed confirmation age.
skill_selections.evidence: diagnostics/location_ranker_20260823.json and the final plan gates

skill_selections.name: how
skill_selections.trigger: the corpus, event, selector, and replay paths span several modules
skill_selections.decision: Trace each path from raw sessions to chronological replay before choosing a seam.

skill_selections.name: research
skill_selections.trigger: the diagnosis depends on local primary artifacts and source code
skill_selections.decision: Audit every causal claim against the artifact or code that owns it.

skill_selections.name: swarm
skill_selections.trigger: the planning playbook requires parallel codebase exploration
skill_selections.decision: Partition execution, evidence, and frontier analysis into three disjoint reports and require a result from every slice.

skill_selections.name: domain-modeling
skill_selections.trigger: cell, candidate lifecycle, observation, commit decision, and outcome read must stay distinct
skill_selections.decision: Use the repository's exact terms and reject any hypothesis that conflates cell conditioning, event localization, confirmation, and outcome evaluation.

skill_selections.name: codebase-design
skill_selections.trigger: each causal signal family needs a testable seam without forcing one data source into the policy
skill_selections.decision: Identify the smallest existing interface that can compare time-valid observation sequences and commit times without making one signal family foundational.
skill_selections.evidence: the alternatives and phase files in the final plan

skill_selections.name: to-spec
skill_selections.trigger: the evidence must become an implementation-ready contract
skill_selections.decision: State user outcomes, implementation decisions, test seams, and exclusions before ticket work.

skill_selections.name: technical-writing
skill_selections.trigger: the deliverable is a multi-file technical plan
skill_selections.decision: Keep the overview explanatory and every phase file action-oriented.

skill_selections.name: show-me-your-work
skill_selections.trigger: the plan resolves a long sequence of failed approaches
skill_selections.decision: Keep an append-only decision trail with artifact pointers.

skill_selections.name: control-cli
skill_selections.trigger: corpus construction and replay run through command-line entry points
skill_selections.decision: Require deterministic CLI receipts for the pilot, build, join, and final replay phases.

testing_choice.reason: The current policy has saved replay receipts and the open frontier has deterministic command-line entry points.

principles.name: principle-fix-root-causes
principles.decision: Separate the missing selector information from already disproved generator, leverage, and model explanations.

principles.name: principle-laziness-protocol
principles.decision: Do not rerun closed searches or wire the R6 speed path before the exact oracle path exceeds its cap.

principles.name: principle-foundational-thinking
principles.decision: Freeze the candidate lifecycle, observation sequence, commit decision, and replay data shapes before testing a policy.
principles.evidence: the final plan's phase data structures

principles.name: principle-redesign-from-first-principles
principles.decision: Design the entry-policy experiment around causal information available by a chosen short commit time, with formation-time entry as one control.

principles.name: principle-subtract-before-you-add
principles.decision: Retire circular age limits and closed location stories before extending the data plane.

principles.name: principle-minimize-reader-load
principles.decision: Make one overview own the diagnosis, scope, alternatives, and ordered phase links.

principles.name: principle-outcome-oriented-execution
principles.decision: Sequence toward an exact replay verdict and avoid temporary compatibility work that cannot change that verdict.

principles.name: principle-exhaust-the-design-space
principles.decision: Compare structurally distinct ways to localize a top-two event, including short confirmation, forward volatility, and non-regime paths.

principles.name: principle-build-the-lever
principles.decision: Ship a rerunnable plan verifier and command oracles with the plan.

principles.name: principle-model-the-domain
principles.decision: Represent cell value, candidate lifecycle, event identity, time-valid observations, commit decisions, and sealed outcome reads as separate records.

principles.name: principle-boundary-discipline
principles.decision: Validate each external observation once at its time-aware join, then pass trusted observations to pure policy scoring.

principles.name: principle-type-system-discipline
principles.decision: Give formation time, observation time, event age, commit time, signal family, and outcome-read state distinct fields.

principles.name: principle-make-operations-idempotent
principles.decision: Require corpus shards and receipts to converge after interruption or retry.

principles.name: principle-migrate-callers-then-delete-legacy-apis
principles.decision: Move every corpus caller to the extended age contract and remove the teacher-only delay refusal in one phase.

principles.name: principle-separate-before-serializing-shared-state
principles.decision: Give corpus shards separate outputs and merge only their immutable receipts.

principles.name: principle-prove-it-works
principles.decision: Require pilot, observation, confirmation-age, policy, and replay receipts from their real command paths.

principles.name: principle-sequence-verifiable-units
principles.decision: End every phase with a receipt that unlocks the next phase.

principles.name: principle-guard-the-context-window
principles.decision: Split architecture, evidence, and frontier exploration into file-backed findings before synthesis.

principles.name: principle-never-block-on-the-human
principles.decision: Resolve observable questions from code and receipts while preserving the user's fixed dollar goal and sealed-data rules.

principles.name: principle-encode-lessons-in-structure
principles.decision: Turn nulls, entry-price controls, read limits, and resolution thresholds into executable protocol checks.
